app.title: {app}
app.name: ScrcpyAgent
empty.title: No devices yet
empty.body: Turn on Wireless debugging on your phone (Android 11 or later), then use “Pair device”. USB debugging also works.
device.unauthorized_hint: Approve the debugging prompt on the phone. No prompt? Unlock the phone and press the button below.
pair.title: Pair a device
pair.hint: On the phone: Developer options → Wireless debugging → Pair device with pairing code.
pair.found: Found on the network — tap to use:
pair.not_paired: Could not connect. This device is probably not paired with this computer yet (or it is asleep). On the device open Wireless debugging → “Pair device with pairing code”, then choose it below and enter the code.
settings.title: Settings
settings.scrcpy_version_hint: Other versions may lack some features. Switching restarts adb; close open screens first.
scrcpy.dialog.title: Download scrcpy {version}?
scrcpy.dialog.why: scrcpy shows and controls the screen of a device, and the adb that comes with it finds the devices. The program cannot work without it. Nothing is downloaded until you press the button.
scrcpy.dialog.checked: It is checked against this SHA-256 before it is used
scrcpy.error.unsupported: This system has no official build of scrcpy.
scrcpy.error.checksum_mismatch: What was downloaded is not the file it should be. It was not used.
scrcpy.error.unpack: The file could not be unpacked.
scrcpy.error.storage: The file could not be written.
scrcpy.error.offer.bad_release: GitHub's answer was not a release.
scrcpy.error.offer.no_asset: This release has no file for this system.
scrcpy.error.offer.insecure: This release is not offered over a secure connection.
scrcpy.error.offer.no_checksum: This release has no checksum for the file.
error.scrcpy_release: The release of scrcpy could not be fetched.
error.scrcpy_not_installed: That release of scrcpy is not installed.
error.adb_not_started: adb could not be started with the new version.
settings.adb_backend_hint: If devices are not found or commands fail, try the other option. It takes effect at once.
error.invalid_directory: That is not a usable folder on the device. Use a full path such as /sdcard/Download/scrcpy-agent.
error.not_a_file: This is not a file that can be sent (a folder, or it is gone).
error.bad_file_name: The name of this file cannot be used on the device.
error.no_app: No app on the device can open this kind of file.
error.explorer_menu: The right-click menu could not be changed.
error.autostart: The start at login could not be changed.
error.addon: The add-on could not be installed.
addon.intro: Add-ons add features such as menu entries and buttons. Some ask to run commands or programs on your computer, so only install ones you trust.
addon.pick_folder: Choose the folder of the add-on
addon.run.disabled: Disabled. It stays installed and does not run.
addon.asks_nothing: This add-on asks for no permissions.
addon.asks_intro: This add-on asks for the following. Leave out what you do not want it to have.
addon.permission.run_process: Run programs on this computer. WARNING: it can do anything you can do here: read and write files, use the network, start other programs.
addon.run.failed.timeout: It did not start: main.js ran for too long.
addon.run.failed.unreadable: It did not start: main.js cannot be read.
addon.run.failed.script: It did not start: main.js failed.
addon.run.failed.thread: It did not start: the system could not run it.
addon.denied: It tried to use without permission: {list}
addon.permission.screen_capture: See the live screen of a device. It shows everything on it: messages, passwords, anything.
addon.error.not_absolute: That is not a full path.
addon.error.not_a_folder: There is no folder at that path.
addon.error.no_manifest: The folder has no readable addon.json.
addon.error.already_installed: An add-on with this id is installed already.
addon.error.storage: The list of add-ons could not be saved.
addon.error.manifest.bad_id: id must be 1 to 64 letters, digits, _ or -.
addon.error.manifest.bad_permissions: permissions must be a list of known permissions without repeats.
addon.error.manifest.bad_platforms: platforms must be a list of windows, linux and android, without repeats.
addon.error.manifest.bad_api: api must be a whole number from 1.
addon.error.manifest.bad_settings: settings must be a list of settings that are declared right (see the guide for add-ons).
addon.error.unsupported.api_too_new: It was written for a newer version of the add-on interface.
addon.error.unsupported.platform_not_lis: It does not support this system.
addon.status.no_manifest: addon.json is missing or cannot be read.
addon.status.permissions_changed: It asks for more than you allowed. It does not run until you decide again.
addon.status.manifest.bad_id: id must be 1 to 64 letters, digits, _ or -.
addon.status.manifest.bad_permissions: permissions must be a list of known permissions without repeats.
addon.status.manifest.bad_platforms: platforms must be a list of windows, linux and android, without repeats.
addon.status.manifest.bad_api: api must be a whole number from 1.
addon.status.manifest.bad_settings: settings must be a list of settings that are declared right (see the guide for add-ons).
addon.status.unsupported.api_too_new: It was written for a newer version of the add-on interface.
addon.status.unsupported.platform_not_li: It does not support this system.
settings.launch_at_login_hint: It starts in the system tray, without showing a window.
error.shortcut: The shortcut could not be made.
error.storage: The data could not be saved in the data folder.
error.unavailable: This is not available on this system.
settings.send_directory: Folder on the device for files you send
settings.explorer_menu: Add {app} to the right-click menu of files
settings.windows11_menu: Add {app} to the Windows 11 right-click menu
settings.windows11_menu_hint: Shown directly in the new file menu, independently of Show more options. Registration may ask for administrator permission; the original system setting is restored afterwards. File Explorer may need to be reopened after a change.
settings.app_name_hint: What it is called in the right-click menu, the titles of its windows and the tray. Empty is the standard name.
settings.app_name_invalid: That is not a usable name: 1 to 40 characters, none of / \ : * ? " < > |
settings.explorer_menu_hint: In Windows 11 it is under "Show more options". It is added or removed as soon as you save.
settings.explorer_menu_hint_linux: It is written for the file managers ticked below. In Nautilus (GNOME) the entries are in the Scripts submenu. It is added or removed at once.
settings.file_managers_hint: The file managers found on this computer.
drop.hint: Drop the files on a device to send them
drop.no_device: There is no device that is ready to receive files.
chooser.no_default: There is no default device, or it is not ready.
chooser.has_default: has a default app for it
chooser.type_unknown: no matching type found; the device decides ({count} apps to choose from)
settings.close_to_tray: Keep running in the system tray when the window is closed
settings.request_close: Seconds the request window stays after it went well
settings.request_close_hint: The small window of "send to / open on a device" from a file manager. 0 closes it at once. If something went wrong it stays until you close it.
settings.device_refresh_hint: While a device is usable, its battery, storage and the rest are read again. 0 turns this off.
settings.default_device_hint: Used by "send to the default device" and "open on the default device".
settings.extra_args_hint: Added to every scrcpy that is started, after the settings above.
files.hint: Files sent to a device since this program started.
files.empty: Nothing was sent yet. Drop files on a device, or use the right-click menu of a file.
device_settings.intro: What is set here is for this device alone and wins over the general settings. It applies to screens and windows opened afterwards.
device_settings.bit_rate_hint: Leave it empty to follow the general setting.
device_settings.max_size_hint: 0 keeps the device's own size. A smaller picture is lighter for the connection (1280 or 1920 are common).
settings.scrcpy_mode_hint: The scrcpy window stays the same. The proxy only lets add-ons use what needs scrcpy's internal protocol, such as the live video. It applies to screens opened afterwards.
settings.toolbar_enabled: Show a toolbar with the screen window
settings.toolbar_on_top: Keep the toolbar above all windows (when off, it is only in front of its own screen window)
settings.toolbar_buttons_hint: Untick a button to hide it, and move it to change the order. A change applies to the toolbars that open from now on.
settings.toolbar_hint: On Windows the toolbar sticks to the screen window and follows it. On other systems it is a separate window that you drag by its grip.
console.title: Debug console
console.hint: Lines can contain device identifiers and addresses. Check them before sharing.
notice.audio_unavailable: This phone is older than Android 11, so audio cannot be forwarded.
notice.mdns_unavailable: Network discovery is limited: some devices on the network may not be found.
notice.device_not_online: That device is not ready, so its app could not be opened. Its window is shown instead.
notice.options_unavailable: This version of scrcpy has not been checked for the chosen keyboard mode or bit rate, so the screen opened with scrcpy's own.
settings.bit_rate_hint: 0 leaves it to scrcpy (8). A higher number gives a sharper picture and uses more of the connection; try 16 to 24 over Wi-Fi if text looks soft. It applies to screens opened afterwards.
settings.keyboard_mode_sdk: Standard (no Chinese or other input methods)
settings.keyboard_mode_uhid: As a physical keyboard (the device's input methods work)
settings.keyboard_mode_hint: With a physical keyboard you type with the computer's keys and the device's input method turns them into text, so Chinese can be typed. Set the keyboard layout once in the device's own settings (its physical keyboard page). It applies to screens opened afterwards.
notice.proxy_unavailable: The proxy could not be used for this screen, so it opened without it. Add-ons' video features are not available for it.
toolbar.needs_proxy: needs the proxy: Settings, scrcpy mode
error.not_available: This button cannot do anything yet.
error.not_ready: scrcpy is not ready yet. Please wait a moment.
error.invalid_address: Enter an IP address and port, for example 192.168.1.20:37000.
error.not_paired: The device is not paired with this computer yet.
error.unknown_setting: This add-on has no such setting.
error.invalid_setting: That value is not allowed for this setting.
addon.setting_problem.wrong_type: It is not the kind of value this setting holds.
addon.setting_problem.out_of_range: It is outside the limits of this setting.
addon.setting_problem.too_long: It is longer than this setting allows.
addon.setting_problem.has_control: It has a character that cannot be in one line of text.
addon.setting_problem.not_an_option: It is not one of the choices.
error.connect_in_progress: A connection to this device is already going on. Try again in a moment.
error.unreachable: Could not reach the device. It may be asleep, or its port changed. Check that Wireless debugging is on.
error.unknown_device: This device is no longer in the list.
error.already_open: The screen of this device is already open.
error.pair_not_confirmed: Pairing could not be confirmed: the device did not connect afterwards. Check the code and try again.
error.no_proxy: This screen was not opened with the proxy. Turn on the proxy in the settings and open the screen again.
error.control_unavailable: The control channel of this screen is not available.
error.invalid_package: That is not an app package name.
error.unsupported_scrcpy: This version of scrcpy has not been checked for listing and opening apps.
error.app_list_failed: The apps could not be listed.
error.invalid_label: A name has 1 to 64 characters and no control characters.
device_window.gone: This device is no longer in the list.
device_window.not_online: The device is not connected, so only what was kept is shown.
apps.title: Apps
apps.menu_shortcut_desktop: Create a shortcut on the desktop
apps.menu_shortcut_desktop_remove: Remove the shortcut from the desktop
apps.no_favorites: No favorites yet. Point at an app and use its star.
apps.no_recent: No app was opened from here yet.
apps.keep_awake_hint: For devices that stop accepting touches in an app window once they lock or dim the screen (reported for some devices). The screen stays on for up to an hour while the window is open; the old setting is put back when it closes. Only one window of a device does this at a time.
apps.virtual_display: Open in a separate virtual display
apps.virtual_display_hint: The app gets a window of its own and the device's screen is left alone. If the device cannot do that, turn this off to open the app on the device's own screen.
error.command_failed: The device could not carry this out (exit code {code}).
